# dbs-action: execution-block diagnosis (Adler psychology)

Curated by Skill Harbor — a short pointer to @dontbesilent2025's dbs-action diagnostic: a coaching-style skill that diagnoses execution blocks through Adlerian individual psychology (procrastination as inferiority-preserving purpose, "wanting to earn" vs "earning", manufacture of ignorance, separation of tasks), identifies signals like the execution simulator, mental masturbation, direction-hopping, knowledge addiction, perfectionism and victim narratives, then outputs a cold, direct diagnosis report. Honest caveats: **no license declared in the repository — license unknown**, so this is a short fiche linking to the source, without reusing its content; the skill is written for Chinese-speaking users and answers in the user's language (Chinese or English); its tone is deliberately blunt and unflattering — no motivational cheerleading, which can read as harsh; it is not therapy and carries its own disclaimer directing users with persistent distress to a professional. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
